hits.text: --- title: Dengue — patient guidance source_url_1: https://www.dengue.health.gov.lk/web/index.php/en/information/instructions-for-patients source_url_2: https://www.epid.gov.lk/storage/post/pdfs/fact_sheet_on_dengue_for_primary_care_doctors.pdf source_org: National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU) & Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Dengue — patient guidance ## English Recommended medication for fever and pain: use Paracetamol only, at the dose prescribed by your doctor.

Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. Seek immediate medical attention if any warning signs appear: - persistent vomiting, - severe abdominal pain, - bleeding from the gums, nose, or in stools, - restlessness, lethargy, or cold extremities, - a sudden drop in temperature accompanied by sweating.

--- title: Seasonal influenza — public guidance source_url: https://www.epid.gov.lk/web/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=171:dengue-update&catid=51:message-for-public&Itemid=487&lang=en source_org: Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka note: Public-health guidance summarised from Epidemiology Unit communications. accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Seasonal influenza — public guidance ## English Influenza is a viral infection. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Misuse of antibiotics for viral illnesses contributes to antimicrobial resistance, a public-health concern that the Ministry of Health has highlighted in successive advisories.

Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. Home remedies (papaya leaf juice, lime juice, herbal preparations) are not proven cures for dengue and must not replace medical care. ## සිංහල (summary) ඩෙංගු සාථකව උෂ්ණත්වය හා වේදනාව පාලනය සඳහා පාරසිටමෝල් පමණක් භාවිතා කරන්න.

--- title: Antenatal care — schedule and structure source_url: https://fhb.health.gov.lk/index.php/en/technical-units/antenatal-postnatal-care-unit secondary_url: https://fhb.health.gov.lk/index.php/en/technical-units/maternal-care-unit source_org: Family Health Bureau (FHB), Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Antenatal care — schedule and structure ## English Antenatal care should begin as soon as a pregnancy is suspected, preferably before 12 weeks. In Sri Lanka antenatal care is delivered in two modalities: - Domiciliary care provided by the area Public Health Midwife (PHM). - Clinic care provided by Medical Officers.

A pregnant woman is expected to have at least 8 antenatal clinic visits with a skilled healthcare provider and 3 or more home visits by the PHM during the pregnancy. The first antenatal clinic visit includes blood pressure measurement, urine analysis, blood group testing, haemoglobin screening, and education on nutrition, danger signs, and birth preparedness.

ඉබුප්රෝෆන්, ඇස්පිරින්, ඩික්ලොෆිනැක් වැනි NSAID ඖෂධ භාවිතා නොකරන්න; රුධිර වහනය වැඩි කිරීමේ අවදානම ඇත. දිගටින් වමනය, දැඩි බඩ වේදනාව, විදුරුමස් වලින් රුධිර වහනය වැනි අනතුරු ලක්ෂණ පෙනේ නම් වහා වෛද්ය ආධාර ලබාගන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் மற்றும் வலிக்கு வைத்தியர் பரிந்துரைத்த அளவில் பாராசிட்டமாலை மட்டுமே பயன்படுத்தவும். ஐபுபுரோஃபன், அஸ்பிரின், டிக்லோஃபெனாக் போன்ற NSAID மருந்துகளைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம்; இரத்தப் போக்கின் ஆபத்து அதிகமாகும். தொடர்ச்சியான வாந்தி, கடுமையான வயிற்று வலி, ஈறுகளில் இரத்தப்போக்கு போன்ற எச்சரிக்கை அறிகுறிகள் தோன்றினால் உடனடியாக மருத்துவ உதவியைப் பெறவும்.

## සිංහල (summary) ජාතික ගොඩනැගිලි පර්යේෂණ සංවිධානය (NBRO) පසුගිය පැය 24 ක වර්ෂාපතනය 75 mm ඉක්මවන විට කහ (මට්ටම 1) භූමි කඩාවැටීම් අනතුරු ඇඟවීම නිකුත් කරයි. නාය යාම් රෝග ලක්ෂණ දකින්නේ නම් වහා ආරක්ෂිත ස්ථානයකට ඉවත් වන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) தேசிய கட்டிட ஆராய்ச்சி ஸ்தாபனம் (NBRO) கடந்த 24 மணி நேரத்தில் மழைப்பொழிவு 75 மிமீ ஐ தாண்டும்போது மஞ்சள் (நிலை 1) நிலச்சரிவு எச்சரிக்கையை வெளியிடுகிறது. கடுமையான நிலச்சரிவு அறிகுறிகள் தென்பட்டால் உடனடியாக பாதுகாப்பான இடத்திற்கு வெளியேறவும்.

The Call Centre is operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with 21 call operators. During floods and other declared disasters, the DMC issues Situation Reports through its public-facing reports portal. Citizens are advised to check the DMC site for the current bulletin before relying on older publications. General flood safety advice issued by DMC and partner agencies: - Do not wade through flowing water deeper than ankle depth on foot.

- Store at least three days of drinking water per family member, and charge mobile phones and power banks once a warning is issued. - Keep important documents in a waterproof container, and pack a small emergency kit (medication, identification copies, torch, first-aid). During the cyclone passage: - Stay indoors. Move to an interior room away from windows.

- The eye of the cyclone passing overhead can create a deceptive calm of about 20 to 30 minutes before high winds resume from the opposite direction. Do not go outside during this calm. query: What are early warning signs of a landslide on the ground?

hits.text: Early warning signs that require immediate action include: - new cracks in walls, floors, or the ground, - doors or windows that suddenly start sticking, - tilted trees or fences, - water seeping from unusual locations on a slope. If severe landslide signs are observed, the public should promptly inform the relevant authorities and evacuate to a safer place to avoid the risks.

- Yellow (Level 1) warning: when rainfall in the previous 24 hours exceeds 75 mm, the public should be aware of the possibility of landslides, slope failures, rock falls, cut-slope failure, and ground subsidence, and should be prepared to evacuate to a safe location if necessary. Special attention should be paid to all hilly areas, to man-made cut-slope roads within the affected districts, and in particular to all landslide-prone sites previously designated by NBRO.

query: How much drinking water should I store per family member before a cyclone?

hits.text: - Store at least three days of drinking water per family member, and charge mobile phones and power banks once a warning is issued. - Keep important documents in a waterproof container, and pack a small emergency kit (medication, identification copies, torch, first-aid). During the cyclone passage: - Stay indoors. Move to an interior room away from windows.

- Vehicles should not be driven through flooded roads; even six inches of fast-flowing water can sweep a car off the road. - After flood waters recede, drinking water from open wells should be boiled for at least one minute or treated with chlorine tablets, because standing flood water often contains sewage and chemical runoff. ## සිංහල (summary) ආපදා කළමනාකරණ මධ්යස්ථානයේ (DMC) අවස්ථානුකූල දුරකථන අංකය වන 117 අංකය දින 24 කල් සහ සතියේ දින 7 ම සක්රීය වේ.

- The eye of the cyclone passing overhead can create a deceptive calm of about 20 to 30 minutes before high winds resume from the opposite direction. Do not go outside during this calm. After the cyclone has passed, watch for downed power lines, broken glass, and structurally damaged buildings. - The eye of the cyclone passing overhead can create a deceptive calm of about 20 to 30 minutes before high winds resume from the opposite direction. Do not go outside during this calm. After the cyclone has passed, watch for downed power lines, broken glass, and structurally damaged buildings. Downed lines should be reported to the Ceylon Electricity Board. ## සිංහල (summary) කාලගුණ විද්යා දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව (Department of Meteorology) සුළි කුණාටු හා දරුණු කාලගුණ ඇඟවීම් නිකුත් කරයි.
